claims.text: The hotel has a peaceful lakeside setting in Tu Liem Ward, Hanoi.

findings.quote: Experience warm hospitality and thoughtful service at JW Marriott Hanoi in Tu Liem Ward, Hanoi. The hotel offers a peaceful lakeside setting

claims.text: The hotel sits beside the Vietnam National Convention Center in western Hanoi.

findings.quote: Mễ Trì in western Hanoi, beside the Vietnam National Convention Center

claims.text: The hotel was designed by architect Carlos Zapata.

findings.quote: the hotel was designed by architect Carlos Zapata

claims.text: The hotel's designs tell the legend of the Dragon (Lac Long Quan) and the Fairy (Au Co).

findings.quote: let us tell a legendary story of the Dragon (Lạc Long Quân) and the Fairy (Âu Cơ) through brilliant designs

claims.text: JW Lakeside Gardens is a spacious lakeside garden where guests may encounter birds and small animals.

findings.quote: We are proud to be the only hotel in the city to offer a spacious lakeside garden
As you wander through the gardens, you may also encounter a variety of birds and small animals.

claims.text: Wellbeing on 8 combines Spa L'Occitane en Provence, a fitness center and a suspended pool.

findings.quote: We bring that expectation to life with a combination of Spa L'Occitane en Provence's treatments, facilities of the fitness center, and a beautiful suspended pool.

findings.quote:
Body Wrap

claims.text: Suite guests enjoy Executive Lounge access and in-suite check-in.

claims.text: The indoor lap pool is suspended on the eighth floor beneath floor-to-ceiling windows.

claims.text: Balcony Rooms have a private balcony with views of the lake and the city skyline.

findings.quote: Step onto your private balcony and be captivated by sweeping panoramic views of the tranquil lake and the dynamic city skyline.

claims.text: Guests can take a cooking class at JW Lakeside Gardens using herbs grown in the hotel's gardens.

findings.quote: you can participate in Cooking Class at JW Lakeside Gardens. Guided by our chefs, you'll learn to make some Vietnamese dishes by using the fresh, home-growth herbs from our gardens.
